pre_condition: proj_dir is a non-empty string referring to a directory for which ELP analysis can be attempted.
post_condition: When the ELP backend successfully analyzes proj_dir, returns an ErlangAnalysis object whose .functions, .edges, and .spans attributes are dicts populated with the analysis results for all Erlang source files under proj_dir. When the ELP backend is unavailable or analysis raises any exception, returns an ErlangAnalysis object whose .functions dict and .edges dict are both empty. The function never raises — all exceptions from the analysis backend are caught internally and produce the empty-fallback result.
